owner_decision.quote: i think it is amaizing result already and for sure there is an improvement we can do so i like them and please process with them and finalize the design
owner_decision.scope: Integrated Academy A accepted, with remaining finalization and release fixes authorized. This is not a claim the owner separately inspected each subsequent minor correction.

reviews.reviewer: parent release reviewer, independent of golazo-design-directions implementation agent
reviews.scope: Academy production changes against PR #10, including persistence helpers, role-aware routing, shared shell/dialogs, journal, progress, profile, learning, scope completeness and rendered screen-family composition.
reviews.evidence: Inspected source and visible-control journeys; independently reran targeted persistence/role/import tests. Full existing suite subsequently passed 268 tests. Reviewed actual full-screen Home, Log, Progress, Learn and Profile compositions rather than accepting a homepage-only mockup.
reviews.limits: The parent authored subsequent finalization fixes; those fixes received separate code-review-agent review.

reviews.disposition: No significant issues found. Existing browser regression then passed with real 200% browser zoom and enlarged-text footer focus.

reviews.scope: Bounded exercise access, tournament disclosure, quiz feedback, workout totals and advice-label fixes
findings: Preserve raw confidence skill ID separately from translated label.
Keep quiz feedback mounted when answering completes the daily routine.
reviews.disposition: Both addressed with actual-caller and six-language regression tests.

reviews.scope: Finalization findings, next-day quiz rollover, and source-declared shared-render/scope corrections
findings: Key the retained quiz by its existing UTC date so tomorrow's question is not locked.
reviews.disposition: Rollover corrected and actual-parent regression extended. Follow-up review reported no significant issues. Scope review retained all 220 IDs and reported no significant issues in shared-render declarations.

reviews.scope: Learning/social, calendar/import, profile/progress and shared role contexts
reviews.disposition: Actual visible-control observations, hash/dimension checks and per-context reports are retained in source-8685e11. Executors did not modify application source. Their observations are not represented as real-user studies or independent aesthetic votes.

craft.identity: Pass: the approved cobalt/coral Academy identity, sporting data typography and original tactical/player graphics are carried beyond Home into learning, progress, identity and the shared shell.
craft.composition: Pass: task-specific desktop compositions replace the old narrow phone rail; phone/tablet layouts, long labels, real web-font rendering and the configured non-Windows font fallback were inspected.
craft.cohesion: Pass: all 220 inventoried role/entry contexts have current-source mobile/desktop evidence. Genuinely shared fallback/onboarding and consolidated Home contexts are explicitly declared, retain behavior proof and are not fabricated as different designs.

known_nonblocking_limits: Initial JavaScript remains large; loading optimization is tracked separately in golazo issue #9. No performance improvement, new budget pass or reduced byte count is claimed.
Synthetic fixtures and mocked service responses verify UI behavior, not authenticated production integration or real children.
Chromium on Windows, plus actual Inter/Outfit resource loading and configured font-fallback checks. No Safari, Firefox, screen-reader certification or representative-player usability study.
Existing evaluation API permissions are unchanged: ordinary player/mentor requests are denied. Authorized own-history capture retains existing managed-team entitlement after visible role switching.
The owner acceptance applies to the integrated direction and authorized finalization, not a newly invented approval for each screenshot.
